headline: CNN 📰 MS NOW 📺 and Politico 🏛️ SUE 🤝 Trump's White House Ban 🚫
text:
CNN 📡 MS NOW 📰 and Politico 🏛️ just FILED 📜 a LAWSUIT ⚖️ against Trump's White House BAN 🚫 after the president 🍊 accused them of writing FICTION 📖 or straight up LIES 🤥 about his administration 🏛️!! The trio 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 said their REPORTERS 🗣️ got DENIED 🚫 access to the building 🏠 on Saturday 🗓️ and now they're going FULL 🛡️ court 🏛️ to DEFEND 🛡️ the principle that government 🏛️ does NOT ❌ get to DECIDE 🤔 what the press 📰 reports 📝!! Without any NOTICE 📢 or PROCESS ⚙️ the White House revoked their journalists' credentials 🪪 because it OBJECTED 😡 to their REPORTING 🗣️ and left UNCHALLENGED 🚫 this move THREATENS 🛑 press freedom 🗽 and the public's right to independent journalism 📰 free from government meddling 🕵️!! A journalist from MS NOW 📺 was stuck broadcasting 📡 from a literal street corner 🛣️ outside the White House grounds 🏠 while the big networks cooked up this joint statement 📜 that basically screams hands off our PRESS 🛡️!!

Major US TV networks 📺 later ANNOUNCED 📢 they would SUSPEND ⏸️ their White House POOLED coverage 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 of Trump 🍊 as he heads 🚶 to New York 🗽 for the UN summit 🌐 leaving a potential GAP 🕳️ in coverage that has everyone in the press pool 🏊‍♂️ down bad 😩!! The five big ones ABC 📺 CBS 📺 CNN 📡 Fox 🦊 and NBC 📺 issued a joint statement 🗣️ saying the public has a VITAL ❤️ interest in receiving accurate independent information about its government 🏛️ and no administration should RESTRICT 🚫 a news organization because it objects to its reporting 📰!! Fox News bureau chief Bryan Boughton 📧 wrote in an email ✉️ seen by the BBC 📻 that effective today the TV pool will NOT ❌ be covering designated pool coverage of President Trump 🍊 and there will be NO ❌ replacement pool put in place 🛑!! CNN 📡 one of only five US news outlets in the White House press pool 🏊‍♂️ was originally due to cover Trump's trip ✈️ to the UN General Assembly 🌐 but instead the five-seat CNN booth 🪑 in the basement was EMPTY 🪜 and CLOSED 🔒 with screens turned OFF 📴 while the crew broadcast from public pavement 🛣️!!

Trump 🍊 posted on Truth Social 📱 claiming the White House was NOT ❌ instituting an assault on the Free Press 🗽 and that he was only targeting FAKE NEWS 📰!! The media organizations filed the lawsuit ⚖️ on Monday in US District Court 🏛️ in Washington asking a judge to quickly RULE 📜 Trump's ban unconstitutional and prevent his aides from enforcing it 🚫!! In a joint statement 📜 on Monday they said they were pursuing legal action to defend the principle that the government does not decide what the press reports 🗣️ and without notice or process the White House revoked their journalists' credentials 🪪 because it objected to their reporting 📰!! The First Amendment 📜 forbids the government from ABRIDGING ✂️ the freedom of the press and courts have traditionally interpreted that as preventing discrimination against media based on content of their coverage 📰!! Earlier Trump 🍊 said it's really just cumulative stories over the last few years 📅 and when asked what he meant by others to come he named the New York Times 🗞️ and Washington Post 🗞️ as fake news too 🥸!!

The White House 🏠 had taken control of the press pool in February 🗓️ which for over a century had been managed by the White House Correspondents' Association 🤝 and also barred Associated Press 📡 reporters from limited access spaces like the Oval Office 🕳️ or Air Force One ✈️ over the term Gulf of Mexico instead of Gulf of America 🌊!! AP filed its own lawsuit ⚖️ and that case remains ongoing 🔄 while Trump 🍊 did not mention specific stories that prompted the ban but later said there may be others to join them 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! Some past administrations tried similar moves like Obama trying to exclude Fox News 🦊 from one specific interview in 2009 but after pushback from the other networks Fox got let back in 🛬 unlike this full on exclusion of CNN 📡 MS NOW 📺 and Politico 🏛️ from all pool coverage 🛑!! Trump 🍊 has been frequently critical of news organizations and his administration has launched legal action against outlets including the New York Times 🗞️ Wall Street Journal 💼 and the BBC 📻 with some resulting in multimillion dollar settlements 💰 while his lawsuit against the BBC is still ongoing ⚖️!!

This escalation comes after a week of setbacks for Trump 🍊 with a judge striking down what they called a superfluous lawsuit against the New York Times 🗞️ and now the major networks have left the White House media slot VACANT 🪑 while conservative outlet Real America's Voice 📺 was listed as secondary crew on the New York trip ✈️ where Trump 🍊 will meet Mayor Zohran Mamdani 👔 and French President Emmanuel Macron 🇫🇷!! Empty broadcast booths 📺 sit on the White House grounds after journalists from the three media organizations were denied entry 🚫 and a MS NOW 📺 journalist was seen broadcasting from the street corner 🛣️ outside the secured area 🛡️!! The networks pulled out of pool duties which share material to save costs and space when broadcasting presidential events to the American public 🇺🇸 and the CNN basement booth that is normally manned from early morning hours was completely dark and closed 🔒 with monitors off 📴!! This whole situation has the press corps RILED 📰 up and ready to fight for their First Amendment rights 🗽 while Trump 🍊 insists it's not an assault on the free press but just cleaning up fake news 🥸 and the lawsuit asks the judge to rule fast and block enforcement so independent journalism can stay free from interference 🛡️!!
